record.stopped: Stopped at its sell's simulation: eth_estimateGas on Robinhood testnet refused the EIP-7702 authorization's r or s as a hex number with a leading zero digit (testnet-run-lib.mjs authJson passed the 32-byte words as they were); its finally withdrew the change note to its W and swept that W and the run key back. authJson now sends r and s as quantities. The W that bought still holds its token.

The W that bought still holds its token.
